parameters.jsonBody:
=
{{ JSON.stringify({
  statement: `
    UNWIND $concepts AS concept

    MERGE (c:Concept {id: concept.id})
    SET c.name = concept.name

    WITH count(*) AS conceptCount

    UNWIND $relations AS relation

    MATCH (a:Concept {id: relation.from})
    MATCH (b:Concept {id: relation.to})

    MERGE (a)-[:LEARN_BEFORE]->(b)

    RETURN
      conceptCount,
      count(*) AS relationshipCount
  `,
  parameters: {
    concepts: $json.concepts,
    relations: $json.relations
  }
}) }}
